summary: This tutorial covers basic formatting and text alignment in LibreOffice Writer, a component of the LibreOffice suite. It starts with opening a new document and demonstrates how to align text to the left, center, and right using the toolbar. The tutorial then explains how to insert bullets and numbering for lists, showing how to customize these features through the dialog box. It also covers indenting and outdenting bullets, and how to copy and paste text within a document using both mouse and keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C for copy, Ctrl+V for paste). The session concludes with practical examples of applying these features to create structured and visually appealing documents.
